_comment: Unichain (130) currencies to wire into ChainlinkPriceOracle via SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Every address below was verified on-chain (symbol + decimals) on 2026-09-08. Two entries may share one `symbol` — native ETH and WETH both price off ETH/USD. Unichain publishes only BTC/ETH/USDC/UNI/LINK, all as 18-decimal SVR proxies on a 24h heartbeat — every feed the chain has is wired here. WBTC rides BTC/USD (no WBTC/USD feed on this chain). LINK is Chainlink's canonical bridged token. Wrapped/bridged representations ride the base asset's feed: a depeg of the wrapper itself is outside what the oracle can see. That is the same trade-off already taken for WBTC on chains with no WBTC/USD feed.
